subject: Pricing for Licensed version of Avicenna
body:
Dear Avicenna Support Team,
I hope this message finds you well.
I am currently planning to utilize Avicenna for my research later this year and would like to inquire about the pricing details for a licensed account. I have reviewed the available information on your website, but I was unable to find specific pricing or subscription options.
Could you please provide more information on the licensing costs and any available plans that would suit a research project?
Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your response.

Kind regards,

Lynn Nicolaas MSc.
Researcher

Universiteit Leiden | Faculteit der Sociale Wetenschappen - Ontwikkelings- & Onderwijspsychologie | www.universiteitleiden.nl

subject: Pricing for Licensed version of Avicenna
body:
Dear Lynn,

I hope you are doing well.

My name is Sara from Avicenna. Thank you very much for your interest in our product. We'd be happy to help you with your project.

Generally, our pricing depends on three factors:

  1. The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well)
  2. The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study)
  3. The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll

We offer both project-based and annual subscription licenses. Annual subscription licenses allow for an unlimited number of projects to be conducted. Actually, this could be potentially more cost-efficient because our pricing schema is much more efficient for large-scale projects than for small ones. If you think you may run multiple studies within a year, it may make sense to buy a subscription license.


If you share the above information about your research with us, we'll be able to help you better.


Please don't hesitate with any questions.

Best,

Sara

--
Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)
4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com

subject: Pricing for Licensed version of Avicenna
body:
Hi Lynn,

I hope you had a great weekend. My apologies for not getting back to you sooner.

Thank you for sharing this information with me. I’m here to help you with any questions you may have.

Based on the details provided, if you plan to have different participant groups starting at different times and are uncertain about the number of groups, an annual subscription may be a more flexible and cost-effective option in the long run. This subscription allows you to manage multiple groups without needing to contact us for a new license for each additional group.

The cost of the annual subscription licenses depends on the quota of the license. Our unit of measurement for the quota is called participant/week. Each participant/week, or P/W in short, represents the data that you can collect from 1 participant during 1 week. For example, 100 P/W means you collect data from 100 participants for 1 week. Now you can use this in any combination that you want. For example, instead of 100 participants for 1 week, you could have 2 groups of 50 participants each for 1 week, or conduct 2 studies with 50 participants each for 1 week, as the total again would be 100 P/W.

Based on our experience, a quota of 1,000 participants/week would be a cost-effective approach for your needs, or at least a good starting point. This option can support up to 8 groups of 12 participants for 10 weeks. You can also divide it among more projects, as long as you don't exceed your quota.

> The total cost of this subscription license to collect survey response data will be CAD 1,947.90 (~ 1,298.92€) for the entire year. We have absolutely no limitations on the total number of projects, researchers, questions, surveys, and notifications/reminders.

However, if you anticipate completing the project with a limited number of groups and participants, you might consider a project-based license for the number of groups you are currently certain about. If you later determine that you need to add more groups, you have the option to purchase another license for any additional participants. This option may not be as cost-efficient as the subscription license, though.

> The total licensing cost (per group) to collect survey data from up to 12 participants for the duration of 10 weeks will be CAD 360.00 (~ 240.06€). The license is valid for one year from the issuance date. There is no limitation on the rolling enrollment and you can recruit participants gradually. However, if you want to extend your study for longer than 1 year, an additional 20% will be added to the license fee for each year.

Sorry about the long email. I tried to cover all the topics to make sure you have the information you need to make an informed decision.

Please let me know if you have any questions or need further clarification.

Best,
Sara
